rows.quote:
This study aimed to investigate the genetic architecture and potential causal protein mediators of these rare cardiovascular diseases using integrated genomic and proteomic analyses.

Methods

Genome-wide association analyses were performed within the UK Biobank cohort for Brugada syndrome, takotsubo cardiomyopathy, and pulmonary arterial hypertension.
rows.coder_note: The outcome data are the authors' own genome-wide association analyses run within UK Biobank for three named phenotypes (source, phenotypes and procedure stated); no dictionary row is that analysis (rule C). The definition is thin (no application number or analytic N in the abstract), which a reviewer applying rule C strictly could read as release_not_identified.
